description: Search Sitecore items using the ItemService RESTful API. The endpoint's facet breakdown is omitted unless includeFacets is set — it accounted for 96% of the response on a live CM and is rarely what the caller is after.

database.description: The database to search. Defaults to master.

facet.description: Filter the results by a facet, as 'name|value' (e.g. '_language|en').

fields.description: Restrict each result to these fields. Strongly recommended: a full result carries every field of the item.

includeFacets.description: Include the facet breakdown (names and counts). Off by default: it dominated the payload, 96% of a live one-result search.

includeStandardTemplateFields.description: Include the Standard template's fields. Off by default; a large addition to every result.

name: item-service-search-items
